summary.intent: Manage a milestone from a single terminal using the GSD manager workflow — clean up stale state, advance phases 30-32 through discuss/plan/execute, create PRs, and resolve all reviewer feedback.
summary.outcome: Phases 30-32 fully executed with PRs created and all review threads resolved (19 for Phase 30, 6 for Phase 31); Phase 33 context and roadmap entry created; 73 new SDK unit tests added; FUSE thread blocking eliminated with async FilePointer resolution.

repo: Grafana Faro SDK's TypeScript types reject null for setUser but runtime accepts it; the correct API is faro.api.resetUser() which is a type-safe alias
Global regex with 'g' flag — lastIndex must be reset before .test() to avoid stale state from a prior match on a different string
FUSE single-thread constraint: all FUSE-T/SMB callbacks run on one thread; block_with_timeout per FilePointer inside drain_refresh_completions could block for O(N×10s)
isForbiddenError was missing the response.status path that isConflictError had — asymmetric implementations caught in review
isDescendantOf self-identity: a node is a descendant of itself (returning false was a semantic bug)
Merge conflicts in .planning/ files always take origin/main as authoritative — planning state on main is the ground truth
check-api-client.sh uses git diff --quiet intentionally: it detects staged-but-not-committed output, not whether api:generate was ever run — removing it causes false positives
Phase 28 logger not yet merged; registerFaroTransport wiring in main.tsx is intentionally deferred until it ships
scrubObject needed to handle arrays explicitly — nested arrays were being cast to plain objects, losing their shape

code.finding: HEX_KEY_PATTERN.lastIndex must be reset before .test() not after, to avoid stale regex state across calls
scrubObject array handling: arrays need explicit Array.isArray check before Object.entries, otherwise they get scrubbed as objects and lose their structure
drain_refresh_completions called block_with_timeout per FilePointer synchronously — replaced with tokio::spawn tasks so FUSE thread never blocks on network I/O
isForbiddenError only checked top-level status; isForbiddenError should also check err?.response?.status === 403 to mirror isConflictError
isDescendantOf(node, node) was returning false; self-identity case should return true
hideSharedItem callback was missing p.setSharedItems and p.setError in useCallback deps array
Non-null assertions on uploadFile/download results — should be replaced with explicit assertion checks before access to get useful failure messages

workflow: Worktrees need explicit cleanup after PRs merge — stale worktrees block branch checkout and inflate the active worktree list
pnpm add must run in the correct package directory; if the dependency addition isn't committed with the lockfile, CI fails with module not found
Prettier formatting failures are a consistent CI trap — run pnpm format before committing agent-generated code
Background agents produce worktree branches like worktree-agent-{id}; these need to be cherry-picked or merged into the feature branch before PR creation
Phase 30 went through 3 separate CodeRabbit review rounds — privacy/scrubbing code gets heavy automated scrutiny; invest more in the first pass
Conflict markers can survive a merge commit if the file has multiple conflict sections — always read the full file after resolving, not just the hunks

friction: pnpm add @grafana/faro-web-tracing silently ran in the wrong context and didn't persist to package.json, causing a CI build failure that required a follow-up fix commit
captureConsoleDisabledLevels was passed to Faro but is not a valid option — Faro API docs/types did not surface this clearly, caught only by CI typecheck failure
Merge conflict markers survived in ROADMAP.md progress table after the initial merge commit, requiring a second cleanup commit
Phase 30 required 3 separate resolve-pr-reviews passes (19 total threads) — privacy scrubbing code attracted disproportionate reviewer attention
Phase 31 PR had lint failures immediately after creation due to prettier formatting on agent-generated code
Switching between the main repo and multiple agent worktrees caused branch confusion mid-session — a checkout ended up on the wrong branch after worktree removal
open_items: deleteItem test in packages/sdk/src/__tests__/client.test.ts has a pre-existing failure: ipnsControllerUnenrollBatch is not mocked, left over from Phase 29 changes
Phase 28 logger not yet shipped — registerFaroTransport wiring in main.tsx is commented out and deferred until Phase 28 merges; log level constants also deferred
Staging GitHub Actions secrets (VITE_FARO_URL, GRAFANA_FARO_API_KEY, GRAFANA_STACK_ID) need to be configured before Faro activates in staging builds
Phase 33 (Windows WinFsp async FilePointer resolution) deferred — context and roadmap entry created in PR #385, blocked on Phase 32 merge
D-09 (bin purgeExpired migration) and D-15 (bin.service.ts retirement) from Phase 31 context were explicitly deferred — bin.service.ts has 2 consumers remaining
registerFaroTransport mutable array injection pattern creates tight coupling to Phase 28 logger internals — acceptable for now but worth revisiting when logger ships
